hero.title: See who’s nearby, in real time.

about.title: What is Radar
about.text: Radar shows you people who are physically near you in real time — no swipes, no hidden algorithms. Explore your surroundings, find people close by, chat instantly, and discover local activities with ease.

realTime.title: Real-Time Radar
realTime.description: See who’s nearby and where they are right now.

profiles.title: Complete Profiles
profiles.description: View photos, age, and interests — decide who you want to talk to.

chats.title: Instant Chats
chats.description: Connect with nearby people without unnecessary steps.

nearbyEvents.title: Nearby Events
nearbyEvents.description: Discover concerts, meetups, and activities happening close to you.

privacy.title: Total Privacy
privacy.description: Share only what you choose. Invisible mode when you need it.

geolocation.title: Useful Geolocation
geolocation.description: Radar shows real presence without publicly exposing exact coordinates.

events.title: Events near you
events.heading: Activities happening around you now
events.text: See popular local events. Filter by category and distance, and start conversations with attendees before you arrive.

benefits.two: See how many people are interested
benefits.four: Discover active plans happening right now
